hero.headline: Crafted by Nature, Roasted for You.
hero.description: From the rich soils of Ethiopia to your cup, we source exceptional coffee with character, depth, and a perfectly balanced finish.

origin.title: Ethiopia
origin.text: Ethiopia is coffee’s birthplace — a place where sharing a cup is part of everyday life. Our collection takes its inspiration from Sidamo, Yirgacheffe and Guji. Explore the origins, discover the differences, and find a coffee that becomes part of your own ritual.

cafes.title: Crafted Together
cafes.intro: Step into a Melkora café and slow down. Each location is built around the same ritual — the pour, the conversation, the cup you didn't know you needed.

locations.name: Melkora Bole
locations.address: Bole Road, near Edna Mall, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
locations.notes: Flagship café with full pour-over bar and retail shelf.

locations.name: Melkora Sarbet
locations.address: Sarbet roundabout, off Gabon Street, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
locations.notes: Quiet neighborhood spot. Pair with our single-origin tasting flight.

locations.name: Melkora Piassa
locations.address: Churchill Avenue, Piassa, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
locations.notes: Our roastery café — watch the beans, drink the cup.

newsletter.title: Letters from the roastery
newsletter.description: New single-origins, harvest dispatches, and early access to limited lots — once a month, never more.
